question: Which influential P0554 structural directions survive refitting ordinary cluster-lens geometry, and which fixed-geometry effects were caustic-placement artifacts?

rules: screen softness was the only material structural coordinate with a common fixed-geometry direction across multiple non-Solar domains
screen softness 0.98 tests the smallest shared direction and 0.90 tests the first all-root fixed-geometry response
dynamics addition softness is the strongest galaxy and Mercury structural lever; both 0.98 and 1.02 are Solar safe but point toward opposite galaxy and cluster objectives
lensing addition softness is the strongest CLASH structural lever and has opposite fixed-geometry signs in RX J2129 and the other four clusters
potential-to-radius coupling +0.01 is a tiny structural change that improves the fixed SPARC, CLASH, and RX directions and recovers a raw root, but conflicts with the other clusters

variants.role: galaxy and Solar favored addition direction

evaluation.galaxy: 131 SPARC galaxies with fixed nuisance parameters and exact nonlinear dynamical response.
evaluation.derived_cluster: 84 CLASH equivalent-acceleration points in 20 systems, no cluster amplitude fit.
evaluation.raw: RX J2129 plus four Caminha/CLASH clusters; exact held-out roots after refitting only ordinary geometry.
evaluation.solar: Same analytic Cassini, Earth, Saturn, and Mercury proxies.

interpretation_rules.matched_comparison_rule: Compare candidate and parent RMS only on systems complete for both; report recovered and lost systems separately.
interpretation_rules.fixed_direction_survival: A direction survives only when the sign of its exact-refit matched RMS change agrees with its fixed-geometry matched RMS change on the same requested scope.

claim_limits: The shortlist was selected after inspecting spent structural-screen data and is descriptive.
The five raw clusters are spent at project level; exact refitting tests nuisance robustness, not fresh confirmation.
CLASH equivalent accelerations are conventional-GR/NFW-derived targets.
The structural operators are phenomenological and are not derived from an action.
The compact-halo comparator is deliberately limited and is not a full modern dark-matter fit.
